summary: All 53 hashes match; the actual two-mode two-update native engineering pair, input identity, full stated recovery and descriptive arithmetic are supported by source and consistent receipts. Broader accuracy, efficacy, causality, full-training and goal-completion claims are unsupported.

non_blocking_findings.details: Two serial processes, one seed 2027, the same two augmented B8 batches (16 collated rows), two updates per mode, all observed rows single-GT. This is not 32 independent inputs, a full 4583-update epoch, formal 9508-expression evaluation, multi-seed evidence, real multi-GT coverage, an overall no-effect/causality result, proof of three effective mechanisms, or Nr3D/Sr3D completion. Cross-process matched-box IoUs differ by up to 1.7583370208740234e-06; losses, gradients, changed element counts and checkpoint hashes also differ. No cause is inferred from those differences. Full formal training remains unproven and this audit grants no training admission.

The audit verified archived source and receipts, not raw dataset contents, saved batch/prediction tensors or the checkpoint payloads. Actual identity of the reviewing model/effort is UNATTESTED. Preserve this evidence boundary.
Exact fresh-object model/Adam/scheduler/RNG restoration was checked within each process, not a process restart or resumed-data-stream equivalence.
No changed pairs were seen, and cross-process floating/state differences exist. Neither differences nor equality in these limited statistics support global no-effect or causal claims.

supplemental_read_scope: Staging manifest dataset/source entries and metadata; full launcher and stage source; the staged-hash-matching dataset constructor, ScanRefer annotation, augmentation, GT, detector and __getitem__ paths. No dataset or checkpoint deserialization.

input_integrity.details: All 53 primary bound paths exist; full-byte SHA-256 values match AUDIT_INPUTS.json. Paths were canonicalized with pathlib.Path.resolve. Every primary file was read directly; the historical main_utils copy was additionally compared against the revised file, and all three controller copies are byte-identical.

gt_provenance.details: The actual native get_loaders path constructs ScanRefer train and val Joint3DDataset objects with debug=False. The matching staged dataset source loads ScanRefer_filtered_train JSON/object_id and ScanNet scene objects; instance point indices supply binary GT masks, and object boxes supply center/size targets after native training augmentation and box jitter. GT is not generated from PV predictions. butd=True uses GroupFree detector proposals, while butd_gt, butd_cls, joint_det, detect_intermediate and augment_det are false. The native corresponding-mask consistency loss does use detached predicted masks internally; that auxiliary training target is distinct from the real GT used by the matcher and descriptive IoU checks. No raw dataset files were loaded or independently revalidated in this audit.

same_collated_inputs.details: Both receipts contain the same two complete collated-batch SHA-256 values. The fingerprint visits every dictionary key and nested value, recording tensor/array dtype, shape and bytes; it is computed before GPU conversion. Seed 2027, sampler epoch 1 and generator seed 2028 are set before taking exactly two native B8 batches. This establishes receipt-supported identity of the collated inputs, including targets and augmentation results, not bitwise identity of subsequent network outputs.

retained_e0_initialization.details: The two admissions use the same retained E0 file, SHA-256 ed8455ddc67e4d17018e9cf499197140e15e35db3f5daee55e0eec6846faf0c4. The launch source hashes that file and checks its 615023752-byte size. The preflight checks epoch 0, retained 5677/4920 identity metadata, full key equality, and torch.equal for all 1295 initial model state tensors against E0. The initialization uses existing official/G/support/pretrained-span payloads; optimizer state is newly initialized for this preflight. These are state/identity checks, not a fresh verification of historical accuracy.

native_matcher_and_complete_criterion.details: The mode changes only the last-layer Mask cost source: shared expanded text Mask versus each candidate own corrected Query Mask. Both use >0 thresholding, raw-point superpoint gathering, L1 mask distance weighted 0.0002, class cost 1, bbox matching cost 0 and GIoU matching cost 2. The six non-mask prefixes retain their native matching path. Native SetCriterion returns matches used for box L1/GIoU, token/position labels, contrastive alignment and the native text/own/correspondence/adaptive Mask losses; G correction uses last_indices. Therefore changed matches can affect several loss responsibilities, not only box regression. The selected-C extra loss is separately disabled.

observation_wrapper_preserves_configured.details: observed_matching calls original_matching first, computes the alternative on the identical outputs and targets under no_grad, checks complete one-to-one GT coverage, sorts temporary indexed copies for logging, and returns the original configured list. Neither alternate indices nor diagnostic IoUs replace configured training pairs. The two recorded last-layer events per mode each contain 8 rows with one valid GT; configured and alternative pairs are identical for all 16 rows per mode.

selected_c_disabled.details: init.json sets use_selected_mask_supervision=False. Model construction, observed_loss and both receipts confirm this, and the extra-C loss keys must be absent. The source expressly verifies that the retained parent architecture had C enabled before the current flag is changed to false. This does not establish a never-C-trained parent or isolate removal of prior C training.

actual_updates_and_group_gradients.details: Each process calls the real native train_one_epoch on two deep-copied real batches, with the original compute_hungarian_loss, backward, clip_norm=0.1, AdamW.step and scheduler.step. Hook norms are finite and positive for all five groups in each observed step. All five groups show parameter changes after the two steps. There are 819 changed parameter tensors across groups and 820 saved/restored Adam states; this is not a claim every parameter tensor changed. Logs record both iterations, the diagnostic and receipt gradient/update/loss fields agree, and saved Adam step counters are asserted equal to 2. G reassignment counts are 193 and 293; the combined core/G group is not an isolated G-gradient or efficacy measurement.

checkpoint_and_matcher_restoration.details: The saved config contains the explicit matcher mode. Both checks reconstruct fresh model/Adam/scheduler objects, load the checkpoint strictly, rebuild the criterion using the explicit current mode and assert equality to saved config. The assertions compare all 1295 model tensors, all 820 Adam states including param_groups and tensor/scalar fields, the scheduler, start_epoch=1, Python/NumPy/Torch/all-CUDA RNG. Receipts are only emitted after these checks. Each checkpoint is 841675936 bytes and its SHA agrees between receipt and intake. This is fresh-object restoration within the same process. It does not test a new OS process, a resumed third update, dataloader/sampler-worker cursor recovery, or automatic matcher-mode restoration when callers supply different args.

source_and_import_origins.details: All 14 protocol source pins match the local audited source bytes, using target60_52_revision/main_utils.py (996bc427...) rather than the historical source/main_utils.py (a16c469a...). The only difference between those main_utils copies is 5658/4850 versus 5705/4945 selection thresholds. Staging, admission/helper/protocol/reviewer hashes and all 11 intake file sizes/hashes per mode agree. Actual __file__ origins for train_dist_mod, main_utils, native_model_initialization, models.pv_ground, models.losses, utils and utils.scatter_util are the isolated PV-Ground source root; pcdet.config is the configured existing OpenPCDet runtime. Supplemental dataset source SHA matches its existing staging entry. The receipt records eight origins, not every transitive module, and no fresh remote source or dataset attestation was performed.

score_normalization.details: Descriptive box IoU is ordinary intersection/union for the GT-matched candidate, and own-mask IoU is raw point intersection/union. All observed unions are positive; the analyzer max(union,1) has no effect in these rows. Raw counts support own_query_mask_cost = 0.0002*(union-intersection) within recorded float32 rounding. Arithmetic averages use actual 8-pair denominators. There is no self-max/min normalization and no accuracy is reported. These are GT-conditioned training-match statistics, not deployed last/bbs top-1 accuracy.

result_existence_and_arithmetic.details: Both actual processes have exit code 0, complete controller states, two logged iterations, diagnostic and post-restoration receipt. 28 receipt/intake/admission/source/config consistency checks per mode passed. Independent standard-library arithmetic reproduced every field of all four analysis step summaries exactly, using receipt values rather than executing the author analyzer. The second logged loss is a running mean (text 14.051549911499023; query 14.051549434661865), not the second-step raw loss. No raw predictions/GT tensors were supplied to recompute IoU itself.

dead_code_and_executed_scope.details: The exercised full criterion and observer are called by the native two-batch training loop and produce the retained records. Native formal evaluate_one_epoch and native_metric_order are not called by this preflight. Their mere presence, or a constructed 9508-row val loader, establishes no new validation score. The inherited query_points_generation term is logged as zero here; it is not an added term in this current total loss. Unused DIoU code and G verification helper do not support claims about executed checks.

accepted_claims.claim: The two recorded native engineering runs completed two actual updates each and fresh-object restoration of the stated model/optimizer/scheduler/RNG state.
accepted_claims.qualification: Receipt-supported verification against directly read source, not an independent model rerun.

accepted_claims.claim: Both runs used the same two complete collated input fingerprints and the same 1295-tensor retained-E0 initialization.
accepted_claims.qualification: Network outputs and trained checkpoints are not bitwise identical across processes.

accepted_claims.claim: The complete native criterion ran with current selected-C supervision disabled and finite positive group gradients.
accepted_claims.qualification: C-off is a current loss flag; the inherited state is not never-C-trained. Group gradients do not establish individual mechanism efficacy.

accepted_claims.claim: Within every observed step, configured and alternative matchers returned the same GT-query pairs on that process own outputs.
accepted_claims.qualification: 0 changes among 16 single-GT rows per mode; same two batches reused across modes.

accepted_claims.claim: ACTUAL_MATCHER_PAIR_ANALYSIS descriptive arithmetic matches the retained rows exactly.
accepted_claims.qualification: GT-conditioned training-match IoUs/costs only, not formal accuracy or global matching behavior.

accepted_claims.claim: The eight recorded module origins and the 14 pinned source hashes align with the isolated staged run.
accepted_claims.qualification: This is not an exhaustive attestation of all dependencies or original dataset bytes.

rejected_claims.claim: New formal ScanRefer accuracy, 60/52 target attainment, or a normal-training gain.
rejected_claims.reason: No formal evaluator execution or accuracy result in this pair; 9508 is only a constructed loader size.

rejected_claims.claim: Query-mask matching is globally ineffective, cannot change training, or caused/prevented the prior degradation.
rejected_claims.reason: Only 16 same-input single-GT rows; no changed pairs in them and no controlled long trajectory or population coverage.

rejected_claims.claim: Query-mask matching improves semantic, mask or regression quality.
rejected_claims.reason: Descriptive cost differences at GT-matched candidates do not establish efficacy.
Matching indices feed labels, contrastive alignment, Mask losses, box losses and G eligibility.

rejected_claims.claim: Bitwise identical two-mode forwards, updates or checkpoints, or 32 independent training examples.
rejected_claims.reason: Only collated inputs and initialization are checked equal; recorded output/state differences exist; the same batches are reused.

rejected_claims.claim: Multi-GT, multi-seed, full-epoch, never-C-trained or same-full-model Nr3D/Sr3D validation/training is proved.
rejected_claims.reason: None of those scopes was executed by these two-step preflights.

rejected_claims.claim: Full data-stream restart reproducibility or implicit long-run training authorization.
rejected_claims.reason: The recovery check reconstructs objects in one process and audits selected state components; full_training_admitted stays false.
